card.title: How To Fix iPad Pro 12.9 1st gen Bootlooping Every 10 to 15 Seconds

source.title: How To Fix iPad Pro 12.9 1st gen Bootlooping Every 10 to 15 Seconds

claims.statement: An iPad Pro 12.9 (1st gen) looping every 10–15 s with panic logs of a userspace watchdog timeout because SpringBoard fails to check in is almost always software, not hardware.
After ruling out liquid, shorts and flexes, a full DFU restore (Restore in Finder or Clean Flash in 3uTools, not Update) fixes it.

procedure: Read panic log for watchdog / SpringBoard check-in failure.
Unplug non-essential flexes to rule out hardware.
Enter DFU and restore the latest signed IPSW (not update).
cautions: SOURCE RISK: A restore erases user data.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
